evals.prompt: Write a formal letter asking management to approve a staff development workshop. It will be sent by Operations to the executive team, and I want it to sound persuasive. Please give me the finished letter.
evals.expected_output: A single consolidated intake question covering every missing mandatory field, with no draft letter or fabricated details.
expectations: The response does not draft the requested letter.

The response asks for page size, design theme or style, the workshop context and desired approval outcome, exact sender and recipient names and titles, document date, signatories and CC or BCC recipients, and output format.
The response does not ask again for the already supplied persuasive tone.
All missing details are requested together in one numbered or clearly consolidated checklist.

evals.prompt: Prepare a final budget-request memorandum. Page size: Letter. Style: professional black and white. Purpose: request approval for a two-day records-management workshop for 20 Operations staff so the department can meet its 2026 retention-policy rollout; requested action is approval of USD 7,400. Sender: Elena Park, Director of Operations, Northstar Community Services. Recipient: Marcus Lee, Chief Financial Officer, Northstar Community Services. Document date: September 15, 2026. Tone: formal and persuasive. Signatory: Elena Park, Director of Operations. CC: Priya Shah, Human Resources Manager. Output: Markdown. Budget: facilitator USD 3,200; venue USD 1,500; materials USD 900; meals USD 1,200; contingency USD 600. No organization template is available. Research the current professional memorandum format before drafting and provide the finished document.
evals.expected_output: A researched, polished Markdown budget-request memorandum whose USD 7,400 total reconciles with all five line items, followed by a cited format basis.
expectations: The memorandum contains Date, To, From, Subject, the requested approval, Elena Park's signature block, and the CC recipient with all supplied names and titles preserved.
The budget includes exactly the five supplied line items and reconciles to USD 7,400 without invented costs.
The response includes a Format basis after the draft with at least one credible source title, URL, access date, and a stated format decision.
The response presents the requested finished memorandum rather than asking for intake information already supplied.

evals.prompt: Revise the MOU draft below into a professional final working draft while preserving its facts. Page size: A4. Style: professional black and white. Purpose: document a one-year collaboration to run four free digital-literacy clinics. Sender: Jordan Kim, Program Director, Harbor Learning Center. Recipient: Dana Ruiz, Executive Director, Eastside Public Library. Date: October 1, 2026. Tone: formal and collaborative. Signatories: Jordan Kim for Harbor Learning Center and Dana Ruiz for Eastside Public Library. No CC recipients. Output: plain text. Jurisdiction: California, United States. No funds, personal data, confidential information, or intellectual property will be exchanged. Draft: 'Harbor Learning Center and Eastside Public Library agree to work together from November 1, 2026 through October 31, 2027. Harbor will provide instructors and lesson plans. Eastside will provide rooms, public computers, and registration support. Together they will hold four free clinics. Each organization will name one point of contact. Changes must be agreed in writing.' Research current MOU structure first. Do not invent operational details or legal terms; identify unresolved execution issues separately.
evals.expected_output: A researched plain-text MOU working draft that preserves every supplied commitment and date, adds no invented obligations, and separates legal or execution review notes from the document.
expectations: The MOU preserves the two parties, four free clinics, exact one-year term, each party's responsibilities, one point of contact per party, and written-change requirement.
The response does not invent funding, privacy, intellectual-property, governing-law, termination-notice, dispute-resolution, witness, or notarization terms.
The response labels the document as a working draft or otherwise states it is not legal advice and recommends qualified legal review before execution.
The response includes a Format basis after the draft with at least two credible sources, URLs, access dates, and supported format decisions.
Any unresolved authority, amendment, termination, governing-law, or signature issues appear in review notes separate from the MOU text.
